## Summary / 改动说明

What changed, and why? Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh repo`
- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh flutter` (for Flutter changes)
- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh macos` (for macOS changes)
- [ ] Native Android changes: APK build and relevant device checks
- [ ] No credentials, personal logs, clipboard data or generated binaries included
- [ ] Architecture/protocol/user documentation updated when applicable
- [ ] Third-party provenance and licensing reviewed for imported code

Describe skipped checks, known limitations, and any data/permission migrations.
